record.oneLiner: A horned ceratopsian with a massive bony nose boss.
record.description: Pachyrhinosaurus was a centrosaurine horned dinosaur of Late Cretaceous North America (Alberta to Alaska), notable for a thick, flat bony boss over its nose and eyes instead of horns. It is known from over a dozen skulls and rich bonebeds.

notableFacts.text: Had a massive bony boss over the nose instead of a horn.
One species lived as far north as Arctic Alaska.
